name: mcp-update-plus
description: Weekly MCP server update sweep for pi (auto-runs at session start, 90s delayed) plus the /mcp-update-plus command: forced update now, check-only, or named servers. Includes a dataset-freshness check for opennutrition (repo-pinned dataset zip, sha256-verified, DB rebuilt) and a running-server guard (defer or stop-first; pi reconnects on next call).
author: Sergey
